# Pausa

> A minimal authentication starter for Nuxt projects with Supabase, by Eco Development Studios.

Pausa presents an authentication template with email/password, social-provider and magic-link flows.

## Public pages

- [Pausa](https://pausa.ecostudios.dev/): product overview and features.
- [Sitemap](https://pausa.ecostudios.dev/sitemap.xml): public page list.
- [Eco Development Studios](https://www.ecostudios.dev/): publisher.
